as_of: 2026-11-14 (Overwatch Season 5 of 2026 "Reign of Talon"; midseason patch 2026-11-03, hotfix 2026-11-05)

sources.used_for: Roster (54 heroes), role and sub-role of each hero (data-role/data-subrole on each hero card), sub-role passive text, portrait image URLs
Ability names and descriptions per hero (official hero pages, fetched 2026-11-14)
Latest live patch: 2026-11-03 midseason balance patch and 2026-11-05 hotfix; perks still live; no new hero in November
Secondary (third-party) preview of Season 5; facts confirmed by the official 2026-10 patch notes.
Queue formats: 5v5 standard Competitive, 6v6 Open Queue running, 2-2-2 6v6 Role Queue only as a 4-week Season 6 test
Original hero ban rules: 4 total (2 per team), weighted 7/5/3 vote, max 2 per role (Season 16, April 2025). Superseded in part by the 2026-06-16 patch.
2026-10-06 "Reign of Talon - Season 5: A Grim Doctrine": Doctrine added, Sombra "Moved from Damage to Support role", Roadhog rework
2026-06-16 Hero Bans changes: Preferred Hero 3 negative votes, 5th Lobby Ban slot that can break the 2-per-role limit; Shion added

game_rules.team_size: 5v5 role queue is the standard mode: 1 tank, 2 damage, 2 support. 6v6 Open Queue also exists; 6v6 2-2-2 Role Queue is planned only as a 4-week test at the start of Season 6. The scoreboard reader must handle 5 (and possibly 6) rows per team.

tank.Bruiser: Gain resistance to critical hits. Move faster while below half health.
tank.Initiator: Gain a heal over time after using a specified movement ability.

damage.Recon: Damaging enemies below half health reveals them.
damage.Sharpshooter: Critical hits reduce your movement ability cooldowns.
damage.Specialist: Eliminating an enemy briefly increases reload speed.

support.Medic: Healing allies with your weapon also heals you.
support.Survivor: Movement abilities start passive health regeneration.

game_rules.perks: Perks are live: each hero picks a Minor Perk and a Major Perk (Level 3) during a match (shown on official hero pages; adjusted in the 2026-11-03 patch). Perk choices can change a matchup mid-game (e.g. Winston Revitalizing Barrier, D.Mon Overstrike) but are not visible on the Tab scoreboard portrait.
game_rules.hero_bans: Competitive only. Base rule (Director's Take, Season 16, 2025): 4 bans per match (2 per team), weighted vote (7/5/3), at most 2 bans per role. Changed 2026-06-16 (Season 3 patch): a player's Preferred Hero contributes 3 negative votes, and a 5th "Lobby Ban" slot can break the 2-per-role limit (votes from both teams added; triggers if both teams voted for the hero and it got 10 total votes). So 4 or 5 heroes can be banned. Banned heroes cannot be picked, so the counter engine must exclude them; bans are not shown on the Tab scoreboard and must be entered another way.
game_rules.role_changes_2026: Sombra is now Support (Tactician). Roadhog was reworked (Trash Compactor, Take a Breather, Whole Hog). Do not rely on pre-2026 counter data for these two.
game_rules.stadium: Stadium is a separate mode with Powers bought in the Armory (official hero pages: 12 Powers per hero). Out of scope for counter-picking.
